text:
elaine: heads up: DSAR from user u-9a3 requesting full erasure (")no retention exception"). They asked for chat logs, embeddings, and any model traces. Also noted: recent keystore vulnerability (CVE-2026-9999) might touch archived snapshots. Need coordinated plan. :eyes:

mike: copied. can you attach the request? legal verification ok?

elaine: sent the PDF to legal via DM. user provided government ID and precise time range. legal indicates no legal hold on this account.

nina: if legal confirms no hold, proceed. but because of the CVE, we should capture forensics evidence before destructive actions. legal wants a deletion receipt plus the evidence bundle.

raj: tech notes: embeddings are sharded; indices point to S3 snapshot objects. KMS keys rotate monthly. Some snapshots encrypted under retired keys - need to ensure we remove S3 objects and update manifests. Also check vector-cache TTLs.

mike: plan sketch: 1) Freeze writes for u-9a3 2) enumerate all artifacts 3) snapshot system state for forensics (signed) 4) run deletion across DB, index, and S3 (force delete) 5) rotate any creds used 6) emit deletion receipt and evidence to legal+user.

sam: who will own the forensics snapshot? we need a named owner to avoid waiting.

mike: I can own snapshot generation with SRE support. sre-bot will produce immutable logs and a signed manifest.

raj: SQL to enumerate embeddings (run on replica):
```
SELECT id, shard_id, s3_key FROM embeddings WHERE owner_id = 'u-9a3';
```
also check kv-cache entries: key_prefix = 'u-9a3:'

elaine: RBAC question: who can execute the deletion job? current infra-admins can. proposal: create a short-lived service-account "dsar-erase-<date>" that requires two approvers (security + privacy) to run. record approvers in audit event.

nina: yes. privacy counsel approval mandatory. also include DSAR ID and approvers in audit logs.

mike: deletion job should output an HMAC-signed proof-of-deletion JSON containing checksums, object keys removed, and timestamps. store that blob in an evidence bucket encrypted with a separate KMS key.

elaine: storage nuance: some objects are in Glacier/Deep-Archive. We need a lifecycle override or expedited purge. storage team, can you force-delete? @storage-bot

storage-bot: we can force-delete objects but need a retention override flag set by Legal. If no retention, we can remove even archived objects, but it may take time (expedited purge).

nina: legal confirmed no retention exception. storage-bot: please outline ETA for purge of archived objects.

storage-bot: expedited purge for deep-archive: typical completion 24-72 hours. We can submit a high-priority job tagged with DSAR ID 2026-09-17-U9A3.

raj: additional CVE triage: capture keystore access logs and token usage in the evidence bundle. escalate to SecOps if any anomalous access seen.

mike: implementation checklist for deletion job: 
- mark DB rows with dsar_state='deleting' and dsar_id 
- enqueue s3 delete tasks with retention-override flag 
- invalidate caches and prefix-kv entries 
- rotate service credentials 
- write audit events to immutabledb and produce HMAC-signed proof blob

elaine: we should hold the evidence bundle for 30 days encrypted, then move to long-term retention for compliance (but ensure it is not tied to user-identifying data beyond what's necessary). legal: ok?

nina: legal OKs 30-day retention of evidence bundle for dispute-proofing. After 30 days redact identifying tokens except the DSAR receipt.

sam: timeline? when can SRE do snapshot and then deletion?

mike: SRE can run snapshot today EOD. storage-bot expedited purge submitted now; expect 48h for archived objects. full deletion ETA 72h assuming no holds.

elaine: action owners: mike -> snapshot + run deletion job; raj -> enumerate artifacts and provide queries; nina -> coordinate legal signoff and retention flag; sam -> monitor SRE run and verify logs; storage-bot -> expedited purge job; sre-bot -> produce signed manifest.

mike: one more operational note: ensure deletion job respects multi-region replication — remove objects in all regions and delete manifests that list cross-region keys.

raj: I'll also run a background scan to find any derived artifacts (models fine-tuned on user data) and flag them for manual review. if any exist, we may need to redact or retrain.

nina: callout: for any retraining or derived-model cases, legal wants notified and a separate remediation plan.

elaine: thanks everyone. I'll update the DSAR tracker and ping when snapshot is ready.

sre-bot: snapshot complete: manifest s3://evidence-bucket/u9a3/manifest-1777778000.json.sig, logs exported to immutabledb id=imm-1777778001.

mike: starting deletion run now. will post proof blob when done. :rocket:
